display_name: RDrop 默认头全源 E20 / E50 三种子预算对比
description: Fresh full-five-RX E20/E50 x matched twoCE/RDrop x three seeds; fixed final student default head, per-row clean prediction then independent CPU truth-last score.
stage: Phase1 full-source joint feature training and clean default-head comparison
aliases: RDrop E20 E50 matched double CE
authorization: Current user explicitly asks why not complete E50 three seeds, then also requests E20 budget comparison. Supersedes old E20-only budget and unlaunched second source-fold confirmation for this fixed full-source 12-row comparison; original healthy/completed jobs preserved.

code.environment: ordinary N607 CVS-RFFI Python; CPU2/worker; loader workers0; CPU dispatcher/scorers without CUDA

data.representation: raw received residual/post_sync/noeq IQ; fixed256 packet; deployed160-dimensional id_feat_joint

roles.L_s: 6300 original legal labels, 10% of train pool / 7% of all90000 source
roles.U_s: 56700 original hidden TX, native oldgate/ownEMA only
roles.V: 27000 source health/default-head diagnostics only, no training

data.capsule_id: existing VALIDATED_ONCE Phase1 capsule manifest; reuse unchanged
data.split_id: original registered source/target physical split; reuse unchanged
data.source_days_correction: Descriptive metadata corrected from [0,1,2] to actual native wisig_train_days/day_i [1,2,3]; same exact physical role IDs, no data or run change

permissions.L_s: Original clean L only with two native stochastic dropout forwards; joint backbone/default head
permissions.U_s: Original Gaussian weak/strong oldgate/ownEMA; TX truth hidden
permissions.V: Read-only default-head health; never gradient/EMA/parameter fitting
permissions.target: Fixed168000 clean decisions per registered row, independent default head only
permissions.truth: Fresh CUDA-empty CPU scorer after all168000 row predictions fixed
permissions.claim_scope: Fixed comparison on an exposed clean benchmark; full default-head three-seed training, no new blind/newTX/satellite/Phase2 claim

checkpoint.initialization: scratch for every row, no inherited weights/optimizer/EMA
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Own source_contract/initialization/actual args/completion/freeze checked before final CP deserialization
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source RX1 fold supplies scientific evidence only; no fold or target-selected weights enter full-five-RX training
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final20 or final50 student; no V-best, EMA, averaging, head refit or target selection
checkpoint.real_checkpoint_smoke: Each launcher first saves/reloads own scratch initial_smoke.pt and checks two synthetic packets with no query; PASS continues immediately

execution.gpu_policy: All8 GPUs considered idle first; existing shared receiver_residual_capacity4.lock covers actual and pre-CUDA all-owner PIDs, max3 total/GPU, admission>=12000MiB free. 12 already fixed ready rows; estimated3GiB/row, CPU2/workers0; no healthy process intervention.
execution.stop_rule: Any illegal role/ancestry/query, nonfinite loss/output, incomplete budget, malformed prediction, output collision or worker/scorer technical failure stops pending new launches and preserves artifacts; already healthy own/other workers continue. No automatic retry or performance-dependent truncation/reorder. Source health reported; all12 fixed comparison rows run to budget then automatically clean predict/score.

metric_names: complete trainingCE/pairedCE/KL/U and source V health
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Each fixed final checkpoint native defaulthead168000 independent clean decisions; 18 strata/row
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Fresh CPU truth-side process after row complete; scores never feed training/model/candidate/seed selection
metrics_plan.budget_comparison: E20_RDROP and both matched TWO_CE controls
metrics_plan.goal: Report both RDROP three-seed mean versus84%; E50_RDROP primary; do not choose target-best arm

notes: All12 full-five-RX rows fixed before new target access. Older four-RX E20 fold is source evidence, never the full-source E20 budget control.
E20=13L+7U; E50=33L+17U. Original cosine horizon follows20/50; therefore budget contrast includes schedule and U duration, not the same first20 trajectory extended.

RDrop is established (NeurIPS2021 primary source linked in report). Both arms use same clean L twice. Native CE1 remains; hook adds .5*(CE2-CE1)+alphaKL once. alpha1/0 fixed allsteps; native U/EMA unchanged, no coefficient/layer/parent/dropout search.

Source positive seed01 true RX1 exclusion: TWO_CE69.285714%,RDROP75.158730%, +5.873016pp; source-only, not a three-seed/full-source/target guarantee. TX1 worsened and fitV fell slightly; preserve limitations. The unpublished seed02 fold adapter was reverted before registration or remote launch when user requested this fullbudget matrix.
No NONE/CLEAN_SIG/margin/Fishr/MixStyle/crossfitteacher/averaging combination in this test. Previous completed positives and negatives retained as separate route evidence.

All8 GPU resource distribution concerns pending allocations only. Coordinator manages capacity, not scientific route choices; independent other chats keep their own budgets. Max3/GPU includes every owner and pre-CUDA worker under same shared lock.

Estimated3GiB per worker is informed by preceding source fold2.95-2.98GiB, not measured full-source memory guarantee. Admissionfree>=12GiB, CPU2/worker, loaders0; actual runtime and memory reported after launch.

Fixed clean-only current goal; no satellite training/testing. Scores truth-last after perrow prediction, cannot affect other training, source/model/seed selection or selective retry. Previously exposed benchmark, not a fresh blind trial.

REJECTED_EXTRA_GATE: separate design/spec approval, report-only repeat review, extra source/config/report hashes, or new scheduling platform. One actual code/config commit, focused tests/CP smoke, one independent P0/P1, one minimal preregistration/archive/preflight/compile, independent launch/scoring evidence only.
